title: A question that names a version without its v prefix gets coverage none although the kb spells it v2.1.294
goal: A question naming Claude Code 2.1.294 gets the verdict and fact lines of the same question naming v2.1.294, so a version spelled with or without its v prefix finds the facts that spell it either way

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','Did Claude Code 2.1.294 change any key of the claude -p result usage field'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;print(o.splitlines()[0]);sys.exit(1 if o.startswith('coverage: none') else 0)

import subprocess,sys;f=lambda v:subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','Did Claude Code '+v+' change any key of the claude -p result usage field'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines();a,b=f('2.1.294'),f('v2.1.294');k=lambda o:[o[0].split(' (')[0]]+[l for l in o if l.startswith('- ')];print(k(a)[0],k(b)[0]);sys.exit(0 if k(a)==k(b) else 1)

gates.question: Where does the v prefix of a dotted version get dropped: in kbfacts.stem (every consumer of stem, terms and key_terms sees v2.1.294 as 2.1.294) or only in the pack's own index and rank calls?
